meta.name: Mohamed Youssef Abdelnasser
meta.title: AI Engineer
meta.tagline: AI Engineer | Agentic AI, LLMs, RAG | LangChain, LangGraph, Python

bio: Hi, I'm Mohamed Youssef Abdelnasser, an AI Engineer in Dubai with 2+ years building agentic, LLM, RAG and machine-learning systems. I hold a B.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence (Intelligent Systems) from AAST — GPA 3.94/4.0, Excellent with Honours, ranked 2nd in class.

At Printerpix I ship production Generative AI across 9 international markets, where AI-written campaigns have driven up to 5x the revenue of human-written ones in A/B tests. I built a multi-tenant agentic email marketing platform on LangChain and LangGraph orchestrating GPT, Claude and Gemini, hardened it with an LLM-as-judge review loop and prompt-injection guardrails, and cut model API costs by an estimated 95% with an on-prem vLLM/LiteLLM stack. I co-lead the Dubai AI team of 4+ engineers.

Before that I optimised RAG pipelines and built ReAct agents at Corporatica, taught Python and AI as a Session Lead at Udacity, and led the AI software for the AAST RoboCup@Home team to 1st place in Egypt and 3rd internationally in the Netherlands. My graduation project, BeMo, is an edge-run conversational robot; its first-author research paper is under review.
I work AI-first — Claude Code and Cursor daily — in Python, TypeScript and SQL. Arabic (native), English (full professional). UAE resident, no visa sponsorship required.

description: Built a multi-tenant agentic email marketing platform — a LangGraph/LangChain Python pipeline orchestrating GPT, Claude and Gemini behind a Next.js front end for human steering — whose AI-written campaigns drove up to 5x the revenue of human-written ones in A/B tests.

Hardened the platform with a two-LLM generate-and-review (LLM-as-judge) copywriting loop, classifier-routed model selection cutting model costs 25% and hallucinations 15%, LangSmith tracing, and prompt-injection guardrails.

Cut the team's model API costs by an estimated 95% by standing up an on-prem LLM serving stack (vLLM, LiteLLM) in production, running an open-weight Qwen-3.8-27B model with tiered routing and per-user API keys.

Co-lead the Dubai AI team of 4+ engineers: run 3 weekly engineering syncs, translate CEO and marketing-director goals into technical plans, and co-conduct 15+ AI Engineer interviews across junior, mid and senior levels.

Built a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with 30+ tools, resources and prompts for a third-party affiliate platform, cutting manual analytics by about 80%; shipped outreach and social pipelines that sent 25,000+ emails, drove 500+ conversions and generated 1,000+ social posts.

Developed an ML pricing engine: Elastic Net regression and Monte Carlo simulation (10,000+ scenarios, 95% confidence) across 900+ products, with Playwright + Gemini vision competitor monitoring over 82+ URLs feeding BigQuery back into the models.
Ship across AWS, GCP and Azure with Docker and CI/CD on GitHub Actions and GitLab CI; integration work spans n8n, webhooks, ETL pipelines and marketing APIs (Meta, Pinterest, Google Ads).
Led sessions for the DECI Summer Cohort, supporting 30+ students through Python and AI coursework.
Maintained an 80%+ graduation rate across the cohort.
Led the software side of the university robotics club, mentoring newcomers in AI, Arduino and robotics.
Coordinated competition teams and their software stacks across multiple robotics events.
Optimised RAG pipelines using LangChain, LangGraph and LangSmith tracing with a Pinecone vector database, improving retrieval efficiency and cutting response time by roughly 15%.
Implemented a LangChain ReAct agent with prompt engineering and custom tool-calling integrations (web search, database queries, API calls), reducing LLM hallucinations by 20%.
Contributed across NLP pipelines — pre/post-processing, LLM integration, monitoring and evaluation — handling structured and unstructured data for production deployment.
Developed real-time computer vision and NLP systems with OpenCV, PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers on embedded hardware, reaching 30 FPS object detection and about 0.3s speech response latency.
Led the team's AI software architecture to 1st place nationally in Egypt and 3rd place internationally in the Netherlands at RoboCup@Home.
Completed a machine-learning internship track, delivering applied ML tasks and a final project.

projects.name: Momad's XP
projects.description: This portfolio: a CI-gated Svelte + TypeScript recreation of Windows XP in the browser, with unit and E2E test suites, a working file system, a Python REPL and a Linux-speaking terminal.

projects.name: BeMo (Be Modern) — Graduation Project
projects.description: A personal AI robotic assistant: a LangGraph agent with 4 function-calling tools (mail and tasks, smart home, learning resources, Q&A) running on a Raspberry Pi with local wake-word, speech and emotion models at about 0.5s latency. Modular star architecture over MQTT and WebSocket, with a Flutter desktop app for onboarding. First-author paper under review.

projects.name: EUC RAG Agent
projects.description: A complete RAG system for a fictional university: TXT/CSV/PDF/DOCX preprocessing with cleaning, lemmatization and chunk caching feeding a Chroma vector store, three swappable embedding backends and three generation models selectable at runtime.

projects.name: NexChat
projects.description: A multimodal AI chatbot: document Q&A over LangChain + FAISS, long-context summarization, image captioning via a vision LLM, and speech in and out — running entirely on free-tier hosted models with a full test suite.

projects.name: Lyric Logic
projects.description: An NLP artist classifier: a text-classification pipeline (NLTK, TensorFlow LSTM/CNN) trained on 50k+ lyrics, served as a Dockerised FastAPI REST API orchestrated with Docker Compose and backed by PostgreSQL.

projects.name: Magnus & Hikaru Chess Robots
projects.description: Robotic arms that play chess, combining computer vision board-state detection with deep reinforcement learning and motion planning.

projects.name: OptiCompanion
projects.description: A mobile companion app built with Flutter and Dart, packaged for Android.

projects.name: Celebrity Look-a-Like CNN
projects.description: A convolutional neural network that matches a face to its closest celebrity look-alike.

terminalWelcome.text: Navigate my portfolio like a filesystem — try 'ls' or 'cd experience'.
That's 'ls', not 'dir'. The title bar says Command Prompt; the
shell inside it disagrees, and I sided with the shell.

copy.whoamiAside: ...is whose computer this is. You, on the other hand, are a guest who arrived through a browser tab.

sudo.sudoers: {user} is not in the sudoers file. This incident will be reported.

usage.headline: usage: sudo <command>
usage.aside: Everyone tries `sudo make me a sandwich` eventually. You may as well get it over with.

sandwich.headline: Okay.
sandwich.aside: Made you a sandwich. It is not a real sandwich, on account of this not being a real computer. Enjoy it anyway.

repeated.headline: Yes. I heard you the first time.
repeated.aside: Saying it twice does not make you more of an administrator.

sudo.removeAside: You also just tried to delete a website from inside the website. Bold. Circular. Denied.
sudo.deniedAside: There is no root here, there is barely a filesystem. You are one tab away from closing the entire operating system, which is arguably more power than root.

matrixIntro.text: The rain does not stop on its own. Nothing does, in here.
There is no exit key. There is only Ctrl+C.
(You already knew that. You have always known that.)
